I. Corporate Background                                                               一、 基本情況
         Weichai Power Co., Ltd. (the “Company”) is a joint stock company                濰柴動力股份有限公司（「本公司」）是一家在
         limited by shares incorporated in Shandong, the People’s Republic of            中華人民共和國山東省註冊的股份有限公
         China. It was established on 23 December 2002.                                  司，於2002年12月23日成立。


         The RMB ordinary A shares and overseas listed foreign H shares issued           本公司所發行人民幣普通A股及境外上市外
         by the Company were listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and The               資H股已分別在深圳證券交易所和香港聯合
         Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, respectively. The registered               交易所有限公司上市。本公司總部註冊地址
         address of the Company’s headquarters is 197, Section A, Fu Shou                位於山東省濰坊市高新技術產業開發區福壽
         East Street, High Technology Industrial Development Zone, Weifang,              東街197號甲。本公司所屬行業為交通運輸
         Shandong Province. The Company operates in the transportation                   設備製造業。本集團主要經營活動為：柴油

           Impairment of Financial Assets                                                     金融資產減值
           The Group assesses at the balance sheet date the carrying amount                     本集團於資產負債表日對金融資產的
           of every financial asset. If there is objective evidence indicating                  賬面價值進行檢查，有客觀證據表明
           a financial asset may be impaired, a provision is provided for the                   該金融資產發生減值的，計提減值準
           impairment. Objective evidence that a financial asset is impaired                    備。表明金融資產發生減值的客觀證
           is one or more events that occur after the initial recognition of                    據，是指金融資產初始確認後實際發
           the asset and have an impact (which can be reliably estimated)                       生的、對該金融資產的預計未來現金
           on the expected future cash flows of the financial asset. Where                      流量有影響，且企業能夠對該影響進
           there arises any of the following objective evidences indicating that                行可靠計量的事項。金融資產發生減
           accounts receivable have been impaired, an impairment provision                      值的客觀證據，包括發行人或債務人
           will be made: a serious financial difficulty occurs to the debtor;                   發生嚴重財務困難、債務人違反合同
           the debtor breaches any of the contractual stipulations (such as                     條款（如償付利息或本金發生違約或逾
           he fails to pay or delays the payment of interests or the principal);                期等）、債務人很可能倒閉或進行其他
           the debtor will probably go bankrupt or carry out other financial                    財務重組，以及公開的數據顯示預計
           reorganisations; other objective evidences show that the accounts                    未來現金流量確已減少且可計量。
           receivable are impaired.

         32. Hedge accounting (Applicable since 1 January 2018)                         32. 套期會計（自2018年1月1日起適
                                                                                            用）
             For the purpose of hedge accounting, the Group adopts fair value                 就套期會計方法而言，本集團的套期
             hedging against interest rate risks and cash flow hedging against                保值分類為：
             interest rate risks and exchange rate risks.


             (1)   Fair value hedging refers to the hedging against the risk of               (1)   公允價值套期，是指對已確認資
                   fair value change in respect of definite commitments which                       產或負債，尚未確認的確定承諾
                   are not yet recognized (other than exchange rate risks) of                       （除匯率風險外）的公允價值變動
                   assets and liabilities already recognized.                                       風險進行的套期。


             (2)   Cash flow hedges when hedging the exposure to variability                  (2)   現金流量套期，是指對現金流量
                   in cash flows that is either attributable to a particular risk                   變動風險進行的套期，此現金流
                   associated with a recognized asset or liability or a highly                      量變動源於與已確認資產或負
                   probable forecast transaction, or a foreign currency risk in an                  債、很可能發生的預期交易有關
                   unrecognized firm commitment.                                                    的某類特定風險，或一項未確認
                                                                                                    的確定承諾包含的匯率風險。


             At the inception of a hedge relationship, the Group formally                     在套期關係開始時，本集團對套期關
             designates and documents the hedge relationship to which the                     係有正式指定，並準備了關於套期關
             Group wishes to apply hedge accounting, the risk management                      係、風險管理目標和風險管理策略的
             objective and the risk management strategy. The documentation                    正式書面文件。該文件載明瞭套期工
             includes identification of the hedging instrument, the hedged item,              具、被套期項目，被套期風險的性
             the nature of the risk being hedged and how the Group will assess                質，以及本集團對套期有效性評估方
             the hedging instrument’s effectiveness in offsetting the exposure to             法。套期有效性，是指套期工具的公
             changes in the hedged item’s fair value or cash flows attributable               允價值或現金流量變動能夠抵銷被套
             to the hedged risk. Such hedges are assessed on an ongoing basis as              期風險引起的被套期項目公允價值或
             complying with the validity requirements of a hedge as at the initial            現金流量的程度。此類套期在初始指
             designated date and in subsequent periods.                                       定日及以後期間被持續評價符合套期

           or liability, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most                轉移負債的有序交易在相關資產或負
           advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal or the              債的主要市場進行；不存在主要市場

           the measurement date. The fair value of an asset or a liability is                負債的最有利市場進行。主要市場（或

           use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market                     入的交易市場。本集團採用市場參與
           participants act in their economic best interest.                                 者在對該資產或負債定價時為實現其
                                                                                             經濟利益最大化所使用的假設。

IV. Taxation                                                                      四、 稅項
         1.   Major categories of taxes and respective tax rates                         1.    主要稅種及稅率

              Value-added tax (VAT)                   –   Before 1 May 2018, for the Group’s PRC subsidiaries, output VAT is
              增值稅                                         calculated by applying 17%, 11% and 6% to the taxable income for
                                                          normal taxpayers, but the Group may pay it after deducting deductible
                                                          input VAT for the current period. After 1 May 2018, for the Group’s PRC
                                                          subsidiaries, output VAT is calculated by applying 16%, 10% and 6% to
                                                          the taxable income for normal taxpayers, but the Group may pay it after

           provided for under defined benefit of the plans.                                劃約定的退休福利。

           prior to termination of service. The scheme requires that                       退休金計劃，該計劃要求向獨立管理
           contribution be made to an independently administered fund. The                 的基金繳存費用。該計劃以基金為法
           scheme is administered by an independent trustee in the legal form              律形式，並由獨立受托人進行管理，
           of a fund. The assets held under the fund is held separately with               其持有的資產與本集團的資產單獨分
           assets of the Group. The trustee is responsible for the investment              開。受托人負責確定該計劃的投資策
           strategies of the scheme.                                                       略。


           The trustee assesses the level of capital of the scheme. The                    受托人審核計劃的資金水平。該審核
           assessment includes asset-liabilities matching strategies and                   包括資產－負債匹配策略和投資風險
           investment risk management strategies. The trustee determines the               管理策略。受托人根據年度審核的結
           amount to be deployed based on the result of its annual assessment.             果決定應繳存額。投資組合由19%的
           The investment portfolio is composed of 19% equity instrument                   權 益 工 具 投 資 、58% 的 債 務 工 具 投
           investment, 58% debt instrument investment, 5% insurance                        資、5%的保險業務和18%的房地產等
           business and 18% real estate.                                                   混合而成。

           securities market.                                                              影響。

       3.     COMPARATIVE FIGURES                                                       3.     比較數據
              As stated in Note III. 40, in compliance with the requirement                    如 附 註 三 、40 所 述 ， 由 於 本 集 團 執
              under the Notice on Revising and Circulating General Corporate                   行《關於修訂印發2018年度一般企業
              Financial Statement Formats 2018 (Cai Kuai [2018] No.15),                        財務報表格式的通知》
                                                                                                        （ 財會[2018]15
              adjustments have been made to the accounting treatment and                       號）的要求，財務報表中若干項目的會
              presentation of certain items in the financial statements and the                計處理和列報以及財務報表中的金額
              amounts in financial statements in order to conform with the                     已經過修改，以符合新的要求。相應
              new requirements. Accordingly, certain prior year data have been                 地，若干以前年度數據已經調整，若
